Title: Ayaan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Ayaan - 10 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Meenakshi - 41 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Vinod - 39 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi and Vinod stand near him.]

Meenakshi: "Let's do something fun today."

[Ayaan hides behind the tree.]

Meenakshi: "That's easy."

[Ayaan shakes his head.]

Vinod (surprised): "Ayaan, listen!"

[Ayaan trips over a stone.]

Ayaan: "This is amazing!"

[Ayaan coughs.]

Ayaan (happily): "That's great!"

[A storm breaks over the village.]

Vinod (excited): "Yes, all right."

[The sun is blazing and Ayaan is sweating.]

Ayaan (gently): "Show me too!"

[Flower petals rain down on Ayaan.]

Meenakshi: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
